title: line
description: send a series of linearly stepped numbers

messages.description: set target value and start ramp
set next ramp time (cleared when ramp starts)

body: [line] outputs numbers ramping linearly to a target over a given time in ms, updating at a time grain (20 ms by default). A float in the left inlet sets the target and starts the ramp, using the time set in the middle inlet; without a time it jumps to the target. 'stop' stops the ramp and 'set' sets the current value without output.
